summary: The proof is mathematically correct. Compactness and convexity give the asserted attainment, upper semicontinuity, measurability, and concavity of the score. The pointwise fiber homothety has exactly the factor (1-η)^d, while the cell-capacity bound correctly supplies the separate factor (1-η)^n through a maximum-versus-average argument after the base coordinates collapse to a lattice point. Possible overlap among transported images in one target fiber is therefore not counted. The fixed-score specialization, expanded-cell calculation, and the final necessary counting condition all follow with the stated quantifiers. The final argument proves necessity only and does not invoke a Hall-type converse or an unsupported rank argument.
